maddeler.e:
أنفلت (form VII)
# أَنْفَلِتُ (ʔanfalitu) /ʔan.fa.li.tu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْفَلَتَ (infalata)
# أَنْفَلِتَ (ʔanfalita) /ʔan.fa.li.ta/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْفَلَتَ (infalata)
# أَنْفَلِتْ (ʔanfalit) /ʔan.fa.lit/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْفَلَتَ (infalata)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
